construct_note: FIES moderate-or-severe food insecurity (12-month recall, household or population basis) is not SWS involuntary hunger (3-month recall, Balance Luzon) and not the FIRI index; only direction and ordering can be compared, not levels.
nns_2019_calabarzon: not published (ENNS 2019 covered 2 CALABARZON provinces; no regional estimate, E22)

c1_2021_provinces.reading: FIES 2021 cannot order Batangas and Cavite (90% CIs overlap), so no ordering check of V1 or of the poverty weights is possible.

direction_agreement.caveat: one pair of years, and the 2023 (households) and 2025 (population) FIES bases differ: a face-validity direction check, not validation
